analyses.claim: Earlier DS–TTR uses TTR content in DS processing. Cooper and Larsson explicitly call their recasting TTR-DS: DS tree descriptions, parse states and action rules are represented in TTR. The latter is an additional architectural proposal, not an interchangeable name for a record-semantic backend.
analyses.limits: CL25 recasts parts of DS and concentrates on classical e/t contents. §4.8 leaves further semantic integrations open; §5 describes a detailed implemented grammar as future work. analyses.title: Local backchannels after semantic compilation

sources.version: Published 32-page PDF; fingerprint in paper record
Published ACL Anthology PDF

analyses.claim: A local backchannel waits for a complete semantic unit with no complete binary sister, then leaves that subtree. Ordinary compilation must precede feedback if both sisters are complete.
analyses.limits: Native adaptation of a DS-TTR account. At a complete root feedback is recorded in place. Early/late feedback, dual participant coordination DAGs, grounding-based repair restrictions and a TTR lexical port are not implemented.

analyses.claim: Quoted material is processed by DS actions; the demonstration and echoed/reported utterance are distinct events. Direct reports can introduce an event metavariable and LINK. Per-word context and evaluation changes support shared and mixed quotation.
